introduction: Mississippi TANF provides temporary assistance for qualifying families with dependent children. MDHS handles applications and case decisions.
description: Mississippi TANF provides temporary assistance for qualifying families with dependent children. MDHS handles applications and case decisions.

sections.who: Income, household and program requirements apply. Work-program participation may be required unless an exception applies.
sections.get: TANF provides assistance for eligible families; the TANF Work Program offers employment-related support.
sections.docs:
• Income and household records.
  • Dependent-child information.
  • Requested identity, residence and resource evidence.
sections.apply:
1. Apply

    Use MDHS’s TANF application page or contact the local county office.

  2. Complete intake

    Follow any interview and verification instructions.

  3. Discuss the work program

    Ask the caseworker about participation, exemptions and employment support.
sections.after: Keep notices and respond by their deadlines. Contact the county about reporting changes.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using TANF application; TANF Work Program; Joint application forms. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
